title: CoopUQ: Robust Multi-Robot Social Navigation via Uncertainty-Aware Cooperative Forecasting
one_line_judgement: 值得先保存：据摘要（arXiv 2610.26852）：CoopUQ 把多机器人导航里的一个工程直觉做成了显式机制——用不确定性而不只是占用预测来驱动策…
one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26852）：CoopUQ 把多机器人导航里的一个工程直觉做成了显式机制——用不确定性而不只是占用预测来驱动策略：'predicts future occupancy grid maps through cross-robot spatiotemporal feature fusion and further leverages forecasts and their uncertainty to guide policy via constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning, where the cost penalizes navigation through regions predicted to be occupied or highly uncertain'。动机是单机器人策略在遮挡与 OOD 下 'often fails to ensure safety and efficiency'，因此策略 'can adapt its risk sensitivity under distribution shifts'。证据分两层：Unity3D 仿真下的 in-distribution + OOD 对比（含不同布局、行人流密度与 rushing 行为），加真机实验 'further demonstrate its robustness across various scenes'。代码与视频今日已实测可达：项目页 https://coopuq.github.io/ （HTTP 200），仓库 https://github.com/tasl-lab/CoopUQ 。长尾理由：领域（移动机器人社会导航）与本项目相关性低，但 '让不确定性显式进入代价函数，而不是只进感知置信度' 是可迁移的可靠性模式。
